verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה אַחֲרֵ֣י מֹ֔ות שְׁנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֑ן בְּקָרְבָתָ֥ם לִפְנֵי־יְהוָ֖ה וַיָּמֻֽתוּ׃
verses.ar: وَكَلَّمَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى بَعْدَ مَوْتِ ٱبْنَيْ هَارُونَ عِنْدَمَا ٱقْتَرَبَا أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ وَمَاتَا.
verses.en: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they drew near before the LORD, and died;
verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they offered before the LORD, and died;
verses.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they came near before Yahweh, and died;

verses.he: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֗ה דַּבֵּר֮ אֶל־אַהֲרֹ֣ן אָחִיךָ֒ וְאַל־יָבֹ֤א בְכָל־עֵת֙ אֶל־הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ מִבֵּ֖ית לַפָּרֹ֑כֶת אֶל־פְּנֵ֨י הַכַּפֹּ֜רֶת אֲשֶׁ֤ר עַל־הָאָרֹן֙ וְלֹ֣א יָמ֔וּת כִּ֚י בֶּֽעָנָ֔ן אֵרָאֶ֖ה עַל־הַכַּפֹּֽרֶת׃
verses.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلرَّبُّ لِمُوسَى: «كَلِّمْ هَارُونَ أَخَاكَ أَنْ لَا يَدْخُلَ كُلَّ وَقْتٍ إِلَى ٱلْقُدْسِ دَاخِلَ ٱلْحِجَابِ أَمَامَ ٱلْغِطَاءِ ٱلَّذِي عَلَى ٱلتَّابُوتِ لِئَلَّا يَمُوتَ، لِأَنِّي فِي ٱلسَّحَابِ أَتَرَاءَى عَلَى ٱلْغِطَاءِ.
verses.en: and the LORD said unto Moses: 'Speak unto Aaron thy brother, that he come not at all times into the holy place within the veil, before the ark-cover which is upon the ark; that he die not; for I appear in the cloud upon the ark-cover.
verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Speak unto Aaron thy brother, that he come not at all times into the holy [place] within the vail before the mercy seat, which [is] upon the ark; that he die not: for I will appear in the cloud upon the mercy seat.
verses.web: and Yahweh said to Moses, “Tell Aaron your brother not to come at just any time into the Most Holy Place within the veil, before the mercy seat which is on the ark; lest he die; for I will appear in the cloud on the mercy seat.

verses.he: בְּזֹ֛את יָבֹ֥א אַהֲרֹ֖ן אֶל־הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ בְּפַ֧ר בֶּן־בָּקָ֛ר לְחַטָּ֖את וְאַ֥יִל לְעֹלָֽה׃
verses.ar: بِهَذَا يَدْخُلُ هَارُونُ إِلَى ٱلْقُدْسِ: بِثَوْرِ ٱبْنِ بَقَرٍ لِذَبِيحَةِ خَطِيَّةٍ، وَكَبْشٍ لِمُحْرَقَةٍ.
verses.en: Herewith shall Aaron come into the holy place: with a young bullock for a sin-offering, and a ram for a burnt-offering.
verses.kjv: Thus shall Aaron come into the holy [place:] with a young bullock for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.
verses.web: “Aaron shall come into the sanctuary with a young bull for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.

verses.he: כְּתֹֽנֶת־בַּ֨ד קֹ֜דֶשׁ יִלְבָּ֗שׁ וּמִֽכְנְסֵי־בַד֮ יִהְי֣וּ עַל־בְּשָׂרֹו֒ וּבְאַבְנֵ֥ט בַּד֙ יַחְגֹּ֔ר וּבְמִצְנֶ֥פֶת בַּ֖ד יִצְנֹ֑ף בִּגְדֵי־קֹ֣דֶשׁ הֵ֔ם וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֛יִם אֶת־בְּשָׂרֹ֖ו וּלְבֵשָֽׁם׃
verses.ar: يَلْبَسُ قَمِيصَ كَتَّانٍ مُقَدَّسًا، وَتَكُونُ سَرَاوِيلُ كَتَّانٍ عَلَى جَسَدِهِ، وَيَتَنَطَّقُ بِمِنْطَقَةِ كَتَّانٍ، وَيَتَعَمَّمُ بِعِمَامَةِ كَتَّانٍ. إِنَّهَا ثِيَابٌ مُقَدَّسَةٌ. فَيَرْحَضُ جَسَدَهُ بِمَاءٍ وَيَلْبَسُهَا.
verses.en: He shall put on the holy linen tunic, and he shall have the linen breeches upon his flesh, and shall be girded with the linen girdle, and with the linen mitre shall he be attired; they are the holy garments; and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and put them on.
verses.kjv: He shall put on the holy linen coat, and he shall have the linen breeches upon his flesh, and shall be girded with a linen girdle, and with the linen mitre shall he be attired: these [are] holy garments; therefore shall he wash his flesh in water, and [so] put them on.
verses.web: He shall put on the holy linen tunic. He shall have the linen trousers on his body, and shall put on the linen sash, and he shall be clothed with the linen turban. They are the holy garments. He shall bathe his body in water, and put them on.

verses.he: וּמֵאֵ֗ת עֲדַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יִקַּ֛ח שְׁנֵֽי־שְׂעִירֵ֥י עִזִּ֖ים לְחַטָּ֑את וְאַ֥יִל אֶחָ֖ד לְעֹלָֽה׃
verses.ar: وَمِنْ جَمَاعَةِ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ يَأْخُذُ تَيْسَيْنِ مِنَ ٱلْمَعْزِ لِذَبِيحَةِ خَطِيَّةٍ، وَكَبْشًا وَاحِدًا لِمُحْرَقَةٍ.
verses.en: And he shall take of the congregation of the children of Israel two he-goats for a sin-offering, and one ram for a burnt-offering.
verses.kjv: And he shall take of the congregation of the children of Israel two kids of the goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.
verses.web: He shall take from the congregation of the children of Israel two male goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.

verses.he: וְהִקְרִ֧יב אַהֲרֹ֛ן אֶת־פַּ֥ר הַחַטָּ֖את אֲשֶׁר־לֹ֑ו וְכִפֶּ֥ר בַּעֲדֹ֖ו וּבְעַ֥ד בֵּיתֹֽו׃
verses.ar: وَيُقَرِّبُ هَارُونُ ثَوْرَ ٱلْخَطِيَّةِ ٱلَّذِي لَهُ، وَيُكَفِّرُ عَنْ نَفْسِهِ وَعَنْ بَيْتِهِ.
verses.en: And Aaron shall present the bullock of the sin-offering, which is for himself, and make atonement for himself, and for his house.
verses.kjv: And Aaron shall offer his bullock of the sin offering, which [is] for himself, and make an atonement for himself, and for his house.
verses.web: “Aaron shall offer the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make atonement for himself and for his house.

verses.he: וְלָקַ֖ח אֶת־שְׁנֵ֣י הַשְּׂעִירִ֑ם וְהֶעֱמִ֤יד אֹתָם֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מֹועֵֽד׃
verses.ar: وَيَأْخُذُ ٱلتَّيْسَيْنِ وَيُوقِفُهُمَا أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ لَدَى بَابِ خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ.
verses.en: And he shall take the two goats, and set them before the LORD at the door of the tent of meeting.
verses.kjv: And he shall take the two goats, and present them before the LORD [at] the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.web: He shall take the two goats, and set them before Yahweh at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.he: וְנָתַ֧ן אַהֲרֹ֛ן עַל־שְׁנֵ֥י הַשְּׂעִירִ֖ם גֹּורָלֹ֑ות גֹּורָ֤ל אֶחָד֙ לַיהוָ֔ה וְגֹורָ֥ל אֶחָ֖ד לַעֲזָאזֵֽל׃
verses.ar: وَيُلْقِي هَارُونُ عَلَى ٱلتَّيْسَيْنِ قُرْعَتَيْنِ: قُرْعَةً لِلرَّبِّ وَقُرْعَةً لِعَزَازِيلَ.
verses.en: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats: one lot for the LORD, and the other lot for Azazel.
verses.kjv: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for the LORD, and the other lot for the scapegoat.
verses.web: Aaron shall cast lots for the two goats: one lot for Yahweh, and the other lot for the scapegoat.

verses.he: וְהִקְרִ֤יב אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶת־הַשָּׂעִ֔יר אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָלָ֥ה עָלָ֛יו הַגֹּורָ֖ל לַיהוָ֑ה וְעָשָׂ֖הוּ חַטָּֽאת׃
verses.ar: وَيُقَرِّبُ هَارُونُ ٱلتَّيْسَ ٱلَّذِي خَرَجَتْ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقُرْعَةُ لِلرَّبِّ وَيَعْمَلُهُ ذَبِيحَةَ خَطِيَّةٍ.
verses.en: And Aaron shall present the goat upon which the lot fell for the LORD, and offer him for a sin-offering.
verses.kjv: And Aaron shall bring the goat upon which the LORD’s lot fell, and offer him [for] a sin offering.
verses.web: Aaron shall present the goat on which the lot fell for Yahweh, and offer him for a sin offering.

verses.he: וְהַשָּׂעִ֗יר אֲשֶׁר֩ עָלָ֨ה עָלָ֤יו הַגֹּורָל֙ לַעֲזָאזֵ֔ל יָֽעֳמַד־חַ֛י לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לְכַפֵּ֣ר עָלָ֑יו לְשַׁלַּ֥ח אֹתֹ֛ו לַעֲזָאזֵ֖ל הַמִּדְבָּֽרָה׃
verses.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلتَّيْسُ ٱلَّذِي خَرَجَتْ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقُرْعَةُ لِعَزَازِيلَ فَيُوقَفُ حَيًّا أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ، لِيُكَفِّرَ عَنْهُ لِيُرْسِلَهُ إِلَى عَزَازِيلَ إِلَى ٱلْبَرِّيَّةِ.
verses.en: But the goat, on which the lot fell for Azazel, shall be set alive before the LORD, to make atonement over him, to send him away for Azazel into the wilderness.
verses.kjv: But the goat, on which the lot fell to be the scapegoat, shall be presented alive before the LORD, to make an atonement with him, [and] to let him go for a scapegoat into the wilderness.
verses.web: But the goat on which the lot fell for the scapegoat shall be presented alive before Yahweh, to make atonement for him, to send him away as the scapegoat into the wilderness.

verses.he: וְהִקְרִ֨יב אַהֲרֹ֜ן אֶת־פַּ֤ר הַֽחַטָּאת֙ אֲשֶׁר־לֹ֔ו וְכִפֶּ֥ר בַּֽעֲדֹ֖ו וּבְעַ֣ד בֵּיתֹ֑ו וְשָׁחַ֛ט אֶת־פַּ֥ר הֽ͏ַחַטָּ֖את אֲשֶׁר־לֹֽו׃
verses.ar: «وَيُقَدِّمُ هَارُونُ ثَوْرَ ٱلْخَطِيَّةِ ٱلَّذِي لَهُ وَيُكَفِّرُ عَنْ نَفْسِهِ وَعَنْ بَيْتِهِ، وَيَذْبَحُ ثَوْرَ ٱلْخَطِيَّةِ ٱلَّذِي لَهُ،
verses.en: And Aaron shall present the bullock of the sin-offering, which is for himself, and shall make atonement for himself, and for his house, and shall kill the bullock of the sin-offering which is for himself.
verses.kjv: And Aaron shall bring the bullock of the sin offering, which [is] for himself, and shall make an atonement for himself, and for his house, and shall kill the bullock of the sin offering which [is] for himself:
verses.web: “Aaron shall present the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and shall make atonement for himself and for his house, and shall kill the bull of the sin offering which is for himself.

verses.he: וְלָקַ֣ח מְלֹֽא־הַ֠מַּחְתָּה גַּֽחֲלֵי־אֵ֞שׁ מֵעַ֤ל הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וּמְלֹ֣א חָפְנָ֔יו קְטֹ֥רֶת סַמִּ֖ים דַּקָּ֑ה וְהֵבִ֖יא מִבֵּ֥ית לַפָּרֹֽכֶת׃
verses.ar: وَيَأْخُذُ مِلْءَ ٱلْمَجْمَرَةِ جَمْرَ نَارٍ عَنِ ٱلْمَذْبَحِ مِنْ أَمَامِ ٱلرَّبِّ، وَمِلْءَ رَاحَتَيْهِ بَخُورًا عَطِرًا دَقِيقًا، وَيَدْخُلُ بِهِمَا إِلَى دَاخِلِ ٱلْحِجَابِ
verses.en: And he shall take a censer full of coals of fire from off the altar before the LORD, and his hands full of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the veil.
verses.kjv: And he shall take a censer full of burning coals of fire from off the altar before the LORD, and his hands full of sweet incense beaten small, and bring [it] within the vail:
verses.web: He shall take a censer full of coals of fire from off the altar before Yahweh, and two handfuls of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the veil.

verses.he: וְנָתַ֧ן אֶֽת־הַקְּטֹ֛רֶת עַל־הָאֵ֖שׁ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְכִסָּ֣ה ׀ עֲנַ֣ן הַקְּטֹ֗רֶת אֶת־הַכַּפֹּ֛רֶת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־הָעֵד֖וּת וְלֹ֥א יָמֽוּת׃
verses.ar: وَيَجْعَلُ ٱلْبَخُورَ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ، فَتُغَشِّي سَحَابَةُ ٱلْبَخُورِ ٱلْغِطَاءَ ٱلَّذِي عَلَى ٱلشَّهَادَةِ فَلَا يَمُوتُ.
verses.en: And he shall put the incense upon the fire before the LORD, that the cloud of the incense may cover the ark-cover that is upon the testimony, that he die not.
verses.kjv: And he shall put the incense upon the fire before the LORD, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that [is] upon the testimony, that he die not:
verses.web: He shall put the incense on the fire before Yahweh, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is on the covenant, so that he will not die.

verses.he: וְלָקַח֙ מִדַּ֣ם הַפָּ֔ר וְהִזָּ֧ה בְאֶצְבָּעֹ֛ו עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הַכַּפֹּ֖רֶת קֵ֑דְמָה וְלִפְנֵ֣י הַכַּפֹּ֗רֶת יַזֶּ֧ה שֶֽׁבַע־פְּעָמִ֛ים מִן־הַדָּ֖ם בְּאֶצְבָּעֹֽו׃
verses.ar: ثُمَّ يَأْخُذُ مِنْ دَمِ ٱلثَّوْرِ وَيَنْضِحُ بِإِصْبَعِهِ عَلَى وَجْهِ ٱلْغِطَاءِ إِلَى ٱلشَّرْقِ. وَقُدَّامَ ٱلْغِطَاءِ يَنْضِحُ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ مِنَ ٱلدَّمِ بِإِصْبَعِهِ.
verses.en: And he shall take of the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it with his finger upon the ark-cover on the east; and before the ark-cover shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times.
verses.kjv: And he shall take of the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle [it] with his finger upon the mercy seat eastward; and before the mercy seat shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times.
verses.web: He shall take some of the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it with his finger on the mercy seat on the east; and before the mercy seat he shall sprinkle some of the blood with his finger seven times.

verses.he: וְשָׁחַ֞ט אֶת־שְׂעִ֤יר הַֽחַטָּאת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָעָ֔ם וְהֵבִיא֙ אֶת־דָּמֹ֔ו אֶל־מִבֵּ֖ית לַפָּרֹ֑כֶת וְעָשָׂ֣ה אֶת־דָּמֹ֗ו כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ לְדַ֣ם הַפָּ֔ר וְהִזָּ֥ה אֹתֹ֛ו עַל־הַכַּפֹּ֖רֶת וְלִפְנֵ֥י הַכַּפֹּֽרֶת׃
verses.ar: «ثُمَّ يَذْبَحُ تَيْسَ ٱلْخَطِيَّةِ ٱلَّذِي لِلشَّعْبِ، وَيَدْخُلُ بِدَمِهِ إِلَى دَاخِلِ ٱلْحِجَابِ. وَيَفْعَلُ بِدَمِهِ كَمَا فَعَلَ بِدَمِ ٱلثَّوْرِ: يَنْضِحُهُ عَلَى ٱلْغِطَاءِ وَقُدَّامَ ٱلْغِطَاءِ،
verses.en: Then shall he kill the goat of the sin-offering, that is for the people, and bring his blood within the veil, and do with his blood as he did with the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it upon the ark-cover, and before the ark-cover.
verses.kjv: ¶ Then shall he kill the goat of the sin offering, that [is] for the people, and bring his blood within the vail, and do with that blood as he did with the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it upon the mercy seat, and before the mercy seat:
verses.web: “Then he shall kill the goat of the sin offering that is for the people, and bring his blood within the veil, and do with his blood as he did with the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it on the mercy seat and before the mercy seat.

verses.he: וְכִפֶּ֣ר עַל־הַקֹּ֗דֶשׁ מִטֻּמְאֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּמִפִּשְׁעֵיהֶ֖ם לְכָל־חַטֹּאתָ֑ם וְכֵ֤ן יַעֲשֶׂה֙ לְאֹ֣הֶל מֹועֵ֔ד הַשֹּׁכֵ֣ן אִתָּ֔ם בְּתֹ֖וךְ טֻמְאֹתָֽם׃
verses.ar: فَيُكَفِّرُ عَنِ ٱلْقُدْسِ مِنْ نَجَاسَاتِ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَمِنْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ مَعَ كُلِّ خَطَايَاهُمْ. وَهَكَذَا يَفْعَلُ لِخَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ ٱلْقَائِمَةِ بَيْنَهُمْ فِي وَسَطِ نَجَاسَاتِهِمْ.
verses.en: And he shall make atonement for the holy place, because of the uncleannesses of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions, even all their sins; and so shall he do for the tent of meeting, that dwelleth with them in the midst of their uncleannesses.
verses.kjv: And he shall make an atonement for the holy [place], because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions in all their sins: and so shall he do for the tabernacle of the congregation, that remaineth among them in the midst of their uncleanness.
verses.web: He shall make atonement for the Holy Place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions, even all their sins; and so he shall do for the Tent of Meeting that dwells with them in the middle of their uncleanness.

verses.he: וְכָל־אָדָ֞ם לֹא־יִהְיֶ֣ה ׀ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מֹועֵ֗ד בְּבֹאֹ֛ו לְכַפֵּ֥ר בַּקֹּ֖דֶשׁ עַד־צֵאתֹ֑ו וְכִפֶּ֤ר בַּעֲדֹו֙ וּבְעַ֣ד בֵּיתֹ֔ו וּבְעַ֖ד כָּל־קְהַ֥ל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.ar: وَلَا يَكُنْ إِنْسَانٌ فِي خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ مِنْ دُخُولِهِ لِلتَّكْفِيرِ فِي ٱلْقُدْسِ إِلَى خُرُوجِهِ، فَيُكَفِّرُ عَنْ نَفْسِهِ وَعَنْ بَيْتِهِ وَعَنْ كُلِّ جَمَاعَةِ إِسْرَائِيلَ.
verses.en: And there shall be no man in the tent of meeting when he goeth in to make atonement in the holy place, until he come out, and have made atonement for himself, and for his household, and for all the assembly of Israel.
verses.kjv: And there shall be no man in the tabernacle of the congregation when he goeth in to make an atonement in the holy [place], until he come out, and have made an atonement for himself, and for his household, and for all the congregation of Israel.
verses.web: No one shall be in the Tent of Meeting when he enters to make atonement in the Holy Place, until he comes out, and has made atonement for himself and for his household, and for all the assembly of Israel.

verses.he: וְיָצָ֗א אֶל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֛חַ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לִפְנֵֽי־יְהוָ֖ה וְכִפֶּ֣ר עָלָ֑יו וְלָקַ֞ח מִדַּ֤ם הַפָּר֙ וּמִדַּ֣ם הַשָּׂעִ֔יר וְנָתַ֛ן עַל־קַרְנֹ֥ות הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.ar: ثُمَّ يَخْرُجُ إِلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ ٱلَّذِي أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ وَيُكَفِّرُ عَنْهُ. يَأْخُذُ مِنْ دَمِ ٱلثَّوْرِ وَمِنْ دَمِ ٱلتَّيْسِ وَيَجْعَلُ عَلَى قُرُونِ ٱلْمَذْبَحِ مُسْتَدِيرًا.
verses.en: And he shall go out unto the altar that is before the LORD, and make atonement for it; and shall take of the blood of the bullock, and of the blood of the goat, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about.
verses.kjv: And he shall go out unto the altar that [is] before the LORD, and make an atonement for it; and shall take of the blood of the bullock, and of the blood of the goat, and put [it] upon the horns of the altar round about.
verses.web: “He shall go out to the altar that is before Yahweh and make atonement for it, and shall take some of the bull’s blood, and some of the goat’s blood, and put it around on the horns of the altar.

verses.he: וְהִזָּ֨ה עָלָ֧יו מִן־הַדָּ֛ם בְּאֶצְבָּעֹ֖ו שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֑ים וְטִהֲרֹ֣ו וְקִדְּשֹׁ֔ו מִטֻּמְאֹ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.ar: وَيَنْضِحُ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلدَّمِ بِإِصْبَعِهِ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ، وَيُطَهِّرُهُ وَيُقَدِّسُهُ مِنْ نَجَاسَاتِ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ.
verses.en: And he shall sprinkle of the blood upon it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and hallow it from the uncleannesses of the children of Israel.
verses.kjv: And he shall sprinkle of the blood upon it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and hallow it from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.
verses.web: He shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and make it holy from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.

verses.he: וְכִלָּה֙ מִכַּפֵּ֣ר אֶת־הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וְאֶת־אֹ֥הֶל מֹועֵ֖ד וְאֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְהִקְרִ֖יב אֶת־הַשָּׂעִ֥יר הֶחָֽי׃
verses.ar: «وَمَتَى فَرَغَ مِنَ ٱلتَّكْفِيرِ عَنِ ٱلْقُدْسِ وَعَنْ خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ وَعَنِ ٱلْمَذْبَحِ، يُقَدِّمُ ٱلتَّيْسَ ٱلْحَيَّ.
verses.en: And when he hath made an end of atoning for the holy place, and the tent of meeting, and the altar, he shall present the live goat.
verses.kjv: ¶ And when he hath made an end of reconciling the holy [place], and the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar, he shall bring the live goat:
verses.web: “When he has finished atoning for the Holy Place, the Tent of Meeting, and the altar, he shall present the live goat.

verses.he: וְסָמַ֨ךְ אַהֲרֹ֜ן אֶת־שְׁתֵּ֣י *יָדֹו (יָדָ֗יו) עַ֨ל רֹ֣אשׁ הַשָּׂעִיר֮ הַחַי֒ וְהִתְוַדָּ֣ה עָלָ֗יו אֶת־כָּל־עֲוֹנֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאֶת־כָּל־פִּשְׁעֵיהֶ֖ם לְכָל־חַטֹּאתָ֑ם וְנָתַ֤ן אֹתָם֙ עַל־רֹ֣אשׁ הַשָּׂעִ֔יר וְשִׁלַּ֛ח בְּיַד־אִ֥ישׁ עִתִּ֖י הַמִּדְבָּֽרָה׃
verses.ar: وَيَضَعُ هَارُونُ يَدَيْهِ عَلَى رَأْسِ ٱلتَّيْسِ ٱلْحَيِّ وَيُقِرُّ عَلَيْهِ بِكُلِّ ذُنُوبِ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ، وَكُلِّ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ مَعَ كُلِّ خَطَايَاهُمْ، وَيَجْعَلُهَا عَلَى رَأْسِ ٱلتَّيْسِ، وَيُرْسِلُهُ بِيَدِ مَنْ يُلَاقِيهِ إِلَى ٱلْبَرِّيَّةِ،
verses.en: And Aaron shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions, even all their sins; and he shall put them upon the head of the goat, and shall send him away by the hand of an appointed man into the wilderness.
verses.kjv: And Aaron shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions in all their sins, putting them upon the head of the goat, and shall send [him] away by the hand of a fit man into the wilderness:
verses.web: Aaron shall lay both his hands on the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions, even all their sins; and he shall put them on the head of the goat, and shall send him away into the wilderness by the hand of a man who is ready.

verses.he: וְנָשָׂ֨א הַשָּׂעִ֥יר עָלָ֛יו אֶת־כָּל־עֲוֹנֹתָ֖ם אֶל־אֶ֣רֶץ גְּזֵרָ֑ה וְשִׁלַּ֥ח אֶת־הַשָּׂעִ֖יר בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.ar: لِيَحْمِلَ ٱلتَّيْسُ عَلَيْهِ كُلَّ ذُنُوبِهِمْ إِلَى أَرْضٍ مُقْفِرَةٍ، فَيُطْلِقُ ٱلتَّيْسَ فِي ٱلْبَرِّيَّةِ.
verses.en: And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land which is cut off; and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.
verses.kjv: And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land not inhabited: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.
verses.web: The goat shall carry all their iniquities on himself to a solitary land, and he shall release the goat in the wilderness.

verses.he: וּבָ֤א אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶל־אֹ֣הֶל מֹועֵ֔ד וּפָשַׁט֙ אֶת־בִּגְדֵ֣י הַבָּ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָבַ֖שׁ בְּבֹאֹ֣ו אֶל־הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וְהִנִּיחָ֖ם שָֽׁם׃
verses.ar: ثُمَّ يَدْخُلُ هَارُونُ إِلَى خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ وَيَخْلَعُ ثِيَابَ ٱلْكَتَّانِ ٱلَّتِي لَبِسَهَا عِنْدَ دُخُولِهِ إِلَى ٱلْقُدْسِ وَيَضَعُهَا هُنَاكَ.
verses.en: And Aaron shall come into the tent of meeting, and shall put off the linen garments, which he put on when he went into the holy place, and shall leave them there.
verses.kjv: And Aaron shall come into the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall put off the linen garments, which he put on when he went into the holy [place], and shall leave them there:
verses.web: “Aaron shall come into the Tent of Meeting, and shall take off the linen garments which he put on when he went into the Holy Place, and shall leave them there.

verses.he: וְרָחַ֨ץ אֶת־בְּשָׂרֹ֤ו בַמַּ֙יִם֙ בְּמָקֹ֣ום קָדֹ֔ושׁ וְלָבַ֖שׁ אֶת־בְּגָדָ֑יו וְיָצָ֗א וְעָשָׂ֤ה אֶת־עֹֽלָתֹו֙ וְאֶת־עֹלַ֣ת הָעָ֔ם וְכִפֶּ֥ר בַּעֲדֹ֖ו וּבְעַ֥ד הָעָֽם׃
verses.ar: وَيَرْحَضُ جَسَدَهُ بِمَاءٍ فِي مَكَانٍ مُقَدَّسٍ، ثُمَّ يَلْبَسُ ثِيَابَهُ وَيَخْرُجُ وَيَعْمَلُ مُحْرَقَتَهُ وَمُحْرَقَةَ ٱلشَّعْبِ، وَيُكَفِّرُ عَنْ نَفْسِهِ وَعَنِ ٱلشَّعْبِ.
verses.en: And he shall bathe his flesh in water in a holy place and put on his other vestments, and come forth, and offer his burnt-offering and the burnt-offering of the people, and make atonement for himself and for the people.
verses.kjv: And he shall wash his flesh with water in the holy place, and put on his garments, and come forth, and offer his burnt offering, and the burnt offering of the people, and make an atonement for himself, and for the people.
verses.web: Then he shall bathe himself in water in a holy place, put on his garments, and come out and offer his burnt offering and the burnt offering of the people, and make atonement for himself and for the people.

verses.he: וְאֵ֛ת חֵ֥לֶב הַֽחַטָּ֖את יַקְטִ֥יר הַמִּזְבֵּֽחָה׃
verses.ar: وَشَحْمُ ذَبِيحَةِ ٱلْخَطِيَّةِ يُوقِدُهُ عَلَى ٱلْمَذْبَحِ.
verses.en: And the fat of the sin-offering shall he make smoke upon the altar.
verses.kjv: And the fat of the sin offering shall he burn upon the altar.
verses.web: The fat of the sin offering he shall burn on the altar.

verses.he: וְהַֽמְשַׁלֵּ֤חַ אֶת־הַשָּׂעִיר֙ לַֽעֲזָאזֵ֔ל יְכַבֵּ֣ס בְּגָדָ֔יו וְרָחַ֥ץ אֶת־בְּשָׂרֹ֖ו בַּמָּ֑יִם וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵ֖ן יָבֹ֥וא אֶל־הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِي أَطْلَقَ ٱلتَّيْسَ إِلَى عَزَازِيلَ يَغْسِلُ ثِيَابَهُ وَيَرْحَضُ جَسَدَهُ بِمَاءٍ، وَبَعْدَ ذَلِكَ يَدْخُلُ إِلَى ٱلْمَحَلَّةِ.
verses.en: And he that letteth go the goat for Azazel shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he may come into the camp.
verses.kjv: And he that let go the goat for the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward come into the camp.
verses.web: “He who lets the goat go as the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.

verses.he: וְאֵת֩ פַּ֨ר הֽ͏ַחַטָּ֜את וְאֵ֣ת ׀ שְׂעִ֣יר הַֽחַטָּ֗את אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוּבָ֤א אֶת־דָּמָם֙ לְכַפֵּ֣ר בַּקֹּ֔דֶשׁ יֹוצִ֖יא אֶל־מִח֣וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וְשָׂרְפ֣וּ בָאֵ֔שׁ אֶת־עֹרֹתָ֥ם וְאֶת־בְּשָׂרָ֖ם וְאֶת־פִּרְשָֽׁם׃
verses.ar: وَثَوْرُ ٱلْخَطِيَّةِ وَتَيْسُ ٱلْخَطِيَّةِ ٱللَّذَانِ أُتِيَ بِدَمِهِمَا لِلتَّكْفِيرِ فِي ٱلْقُدْسِ يُخْرِجُهُمَا إِلَى خَارِجِ ٱلْمَحَلَّةِ، وَيُحْرِقُونَ بِٱلنَّارِ جِلْدَيْهِمَا وَلَحْمَهُمَا وَفَرْثَهُمَا.
verses.en: And the bullock of the sin-offering, and the goat of the sin-offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place, shall be carried forth without the camp; and they shall burn in the fire their skins, and their flesh, and their dung.
verses.kjv: And the bullock [for] the sin offering, and the goat [for] the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy [place], shall [one] carry forth without the camp; and they shall burn in the fire their skins, and their flesh, and their dung.
verses.web: The bull for the sin offering, and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the Holy Place, shall be carried outside the camp; and they shall burn their skins, their flesh, and their dung with fire.

verses.he: וְהַשֹּׂרֵ֣ף אֹתָ֔ם יְכַבֵּ֣ס בְּגָדָ֔יו וְרָחַ֥ץ אֶת־בְּשָׂרֹ֖ו בַּמָּ֑יִם וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵ֖ן יָבֹ֥וא אֶל־הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِي يُحْرِقُهُمَا يَغْسِلُ ثِيَابَهُ وَيَرْحَضُ جَسَدَهُ بِمَاءٍ، وَبَعْدَ ذَلِكَ يَدْخُلُ إِلَى ٱلْمَحَلَّةِ.
verses.en: And he that burneth them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he may come into the camp.
verses.kjv: And he that burneth them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.
verses.web: He who burns them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.

verses.he: וְהָיְתָ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם לְחֻקַּ֣ת עֹולָ֑ם בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ֠שְּׁבִיעִי בֶּֽעָשֹׂ֨ור לַחֹ֜דֶשׁ תְּעַנּ֣וּ אֶת־נַפְשֹֽׁתֵיכֶ֗ם וְכָל־מְלָאכָה֙ לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּ הָֽאֶזְרָ֔ח וְהַגֵּ֖ר הַגָּ֥ר בְּתֹוכְכֶֽם׃
verses.ar: «وَيَكُونُ لَكُمْ فَرِيضَةً دَهْرِيَّةً، أَنَّكُمْ فِي ٱلشَّهْرِ ٱلسَّابِعِ فِي عَاشِرِ ٱلشَّهْرِ تُذَلِّلُونَ نُفُوسَكُمْ، وَكُلَّ عَمَلٍ لَا تَعْمَلُونَ: ٱلْوَطَنِيُّ وَٱلْغَرِيبُ ٱلنَّازِلُ فِي وَسَطِكُمْ.
verses.en: And it shall be a statute for ever unto you: in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, ye shall afflict your souls, and shall do no manner of work, the home-born, or the stranger that sojourneth among you.
verses.kjv: ¶ And [this] shall be a statute for ever unto you: [that] in the seventh month, on the tenth [day] of the month, ye shall afflict your souls, and do no work at all, [whether it be] one of your own country, or a stranger that sojourneth among you:
verses.web: “It shall be a statute to you forever: in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, you shall afflict your souls, and shall do no kind of work, whether native-born or a stranger who lives as a foreigner among you;

verses.he: כִּֽי־בַיֹּ֥ום הַזֶּ֛ה יְכַפֵּ֥ר עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם לְטַהֵ֣ר אֶתְכֶ֑ם מִכֹּל֙ חַטֹּ֣אתֵיכֶ֔ם לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה תִּטְהָֽרוּ׃
verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ فِي هَذَا ٱلْيَوْمِ يُكَفِّرُ عَنْكُمْ لِتَطْهِيرِكُمْ. مِنْ جَمِيعِ خَطَايَاكُمْ أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ تَطْهُرُونَ.
verses.en: For on this day shall atonement be made for you, to cleanse you; from all your sins shall ye be clean before the LORD.
verses.kjv: For on that day shall [the priest] make an atonement for you, to cleanse you, [that] ye may be clean from all your sins before the LORD.
verses.web: for on this day shall atonement be made for you, to cleanse you. You shall be clean from all your sins before Yahweh.

verses.he: שַׁבַּ֨ת שַׁבָּתֹ֥ון הִיא֙ לָכֶ֔ם וְעִנִּיתֶ֖ם אֶת־נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶ֑ם חֻקַּ֖ת עֹולָֽם׃
verses.ar: سَبْتُ عُطْلَةٍ هُوَ لَكُمْ، وَتُذَلِّلُونَ نُفُوسَكُمْ فَرِيضَةً دَهْرِيَّةً.
verses.en: It is a sabbath of solemn rest unto you, and ye shall afflict your souls; it is a statute for ever.
verses.kjv: It [shall be] a sabbath of rest unto you, and ye shall afflict your souls, by a statute for ever.
verses.web: It is a Sabbath of solemn rest to you, and you shall afflict your souls. It is a statute forever.

verses.he: וְכִפֶּ֨ר הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֲשֶׁר־יִמְשַׁ֣ח אֹתֹ֗ו וַאֲשֶׁ֤ר יְמַלֵּא֙ אֶת־יָדֹ֔ו לְכַהֵ֖ן תַּ֣חַת אָבִ֑יו וְלָבַ֛שׁ אֶת־בִּגְדֵ֥י הַבָּ֖ד בִּגְדֵ֥י הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.ar: وَيُكَفِّرُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ ٱلَّذِي يَمْسَحُهُ، وَٱلَّذِي يَمْلَأُ يَدَهُ لِلْكَهَانَةِ عِوَضًا عَنْ أَبِيهِ. يَلْبَسُ ثِيَابَ ٱلْكَتَّانِ، ٱلثِّيَابَ ٱلْمُقَدَّسَةَ،
verses.en: And the priest, who shall be anointed and who shall be consecrated to be priest in his father's stead, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen garments, even the holy garments.
verses.kjv: And the priest, whom he shall anoint, and whom he shall consecrate to minister in the priest’s office in his father’s stead, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen clothes, [even] the holy garments:
verses.web: The priest, who is anointed and who is consecrated to be priest in his father’s place, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen garments, even the holy garments.

verses.he: וְכִפֶּר֙ אֶת־מִקְדַּ֣שׁ הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וְאֶת־אֹ֧הֶל מֹועֵ֛ד וְאֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ יְכַפֵּ֑ר וְעַ֧ל הַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים וְעַל־כָּל־עַ֥ם הַקָּהָ֖ל יְכַפֵּֽר׃
verses.ar: وَيُكَفِّرُ عَنْ مَقْدِسِ ٱلْقُدْسِ. وَعَنْ خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ وَٱلْمَذْبَحِ يُكَفِّرُ. وَعَنِ ٱلْكَهَنَةِ وَكُلِّ شَعْبِ ٱلْجَمَاعَةِ يُكَفِّرُ.
verses.en: And he shall make atonement for the most holy place, and he shall make atonement for the tent of meeting and for the altar; and he shall make atonement for the priests and for all the people of the assembly.
verses.kjv: And he shall make an atonement for the holy sanctuary, and he shall make an atonement for the tabernacle of the congregation, and for the altar, and he shall make an atonement for the priests, and for all the people of the congregation.
verses.web: Then he shall make atonement for the Holy Sanctuary; and he shall make atonement for the Tent of Meeting and for the altar; and he shall make atonement for the priests and for all the people of the assembly.

verses.he: וְהָֽיְתָה־זֹּ֨את לָכֶ֜ם לְחֻקַּ֣ת עֹולָ֗ם לְכַפֵּ֞ר עַל־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִכָּל־חַטֹּאתָ֔ם אַחַ֖ת בַּשָּׁנָ֑ה וַיַּ֕עַשׂ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ פ
verses.ar: وَتَكُونُ هَذِهِ لَكُمْ فَرِيضَةً دَهْرِيَّةً لِلتَّكْفِيرِ عَنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ مِنْ جَمِيعِ خَطَايَاهُمْ مَرَّةً فِي ٱلسَّنَةِ». فَفَعَلَ كَمَا أَمَرَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى.
verses.en: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make atonement for the children of Israel because of all their sins once in the year.' And he did as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.kjv: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make an atonement for the children of Israel for all their sins once a year. And he did as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.web: “This shall be an everlasting statute for you, to make atonement for the children of Israel once in the year because of all their sins.” It was done as Yahweh commanded Moses.
